title: cohort-orbit-synchronizer-with-telemetry-sheriff
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: production rollouts showed brittle promotions when cohorts with skewed traffic characteristics got promoted out-of-phase, causing transient SLO violations and noisy telemetry that obscured regressions. This PR introduces the Cohort Orbit Synchronizer: a controller that enforces temporal alignment windows (orbits) across related cohorts, a lightweight "telemetry sheriff" process that computes drift signals and issues promotion throttles, and a rollback orchestrator that captures compact checkpoints for fast, deterministic rewind. Goals: 1) reduce cross-cohort interference during staged promotes; 2) make telemetry-driven throttles auditable and debuggable; 3) enable low-latency, safe rollback that preserves session affinity.

Summary of changes: added a new coordinator component (pkg/orbit) with a temporal scheduler that aligns cohort promotions into discrete slots, implemented a telemetry-sheriff service (observability/sheriff) that subscribes to per-cohort metrics, surface-level policy DSL for defining orbit windows and throttle thresholds (config/orbit_policy.yaml), and a rollback orchestrator that persists minimal state snapshots to the rollout ledger for deterministic rewind. The runtime integrates with existing promote/fallback hooks and exposes a small Prometheus surface for sheriff decisions.

Checklist: - [x] design doc reviewed (ENG-1429) - [x] unit tests for scheduler and sheriff - [x] integration test using replay harness (benchmark-lab/canary-replay) - [x] e2e smoke in staging - [x] migration tool to convert existing cohort annotations to orbit windows - [x] runbook updated and placed under docs/runbooks/orbit-sync.md

Testing notes: local unit/integration passed. Ran canary-replay with synthetic cohorts and verified orbit enforcement prevented a 10% traffic burst from bypassing guardrails. In staging we ran a 4-hour soak with three linked cohorts; sheriff injected synthetic drifts to verify throttles; rollback orchestrator executed a rewind sequence (squash-commit style) and restored sessions within expected bounds.

Deployment notes: feature is guarded behind feature flag rollout.orbit_synchronizer; default off for existing customers. Rolling upgrade plan: deploy controller -> enable flag in staging -> monitor sheriff metrics -> enable in limited accounts -> gradually flip global flag. Backout: disable flag then apply a quick rollback of controller to  previous stable image.

Related: coordinates with ENG-1438 (canary-replay extension) and SUP-4422 (incident follow-up on cross-cohort flapping).
